reviewMethod: Read fixed source paragraphs and each selected list leaf. Inherited levels retain AND/one-of/MAY/exception semantics; no behavior support. Preserve eleven old algorithm identities as non-normative observations per REC 1.5, not hidden deletions or new mandatory pseudo-code steps.

constraints.reason: Each listed filename character/range is prohibited by the introduction. Noncharacters' three nested ranges are separate leaves. Dot prohibition applies only to the final character; ranges are the literal fixed REC, not a newly inferred Unicode policy.
constraints.applicability: OCF file names, under the preceding character restriction; byte limits and normalization remain separate requirements.
constraints.phase: T1 input profiles; T2 archive/name validation; T6 writeback

constraints.reason: Four independent forbidden data-URL contexts. HTML/SVG a and HTML area retain their iframe exception; package href includes item AND metadata link; the API branch includes window.open OR document.open.
constraints.applicability: The selected context can create a top-level content document/browsing context. This is not a blanket ban on embedded data URLs.
constraints.phase: T2 references/security diagnostics; T4a authoring; S2-S4 browsing isolation

constraints.reason: Each of eight named resource classes is independently prohibited from encryption. Package document is a class, not a guessed literal filename; reserved optional files are constrained when present.
constraints.applicability: OCF encryption; this does not require every optional reserved file to exist or authorize decrypting DRM.
constraints.phase: T1 resource profiles; T2 container validation; T6 writeback

constraints.reason: Each properties token is required iff the referenced resource matches that token's own manifest-vocabulary definition. The following paragraph excludes recursive application to embedded resources; none is an unconditional token required on every item.
constraints.applicability: Manifest item resource matching mathml/remote-resources/scripted/svg/switch definitions, respectively; declared default vocabulary and embedded-resource boundary apply.

constraints.reason: Audio, video, scripting-API-retrieved resources and fonts are four permitted remote-resource families, not four required inclusions. The separate following MUST keeps all other resources in the container, regardless of core/foreign media type.
constraints.applicability: When a creator chooses external resource hosting; script/API and font permissions do not add runtime downloads or font embedding to Kepub.
constraints.phase: T2 reference validation; T5 CSS/preserved-font references; S2-S4 offline/network policy

constraints.reason: The MAY permits prefixed custom attributes only where the namespace URL domain does NOT include either string. w3.org and idpf.org are exclusion predicates, never allowed-namespace examples; both predicates must hold.
constraints.applicability: Optional XHTML custom attributes; namespace URL domain, not every substring of the whole URL. Subsequent no-information-loss MUST remains separate.
constraints.phase: T1 namespace profiles; T2 validation/preservation; T4a explicit semantics; S2-S4 interoperability

constraints.reason: The required fallback may take ONE OF host-format intrinsic mechanisms OR package manifest chains. Each leaf registers an alternative, not an obligation to supply both. Host element and relevant media/foreign-resource restrictions remain applicable.
constraints.applicability: Foreign resources needing fallbacks; choose an allowed fallback mechanism appropriate to placement and host format.
constraints.phase: T2 resource/reference model; T3 migration; S2-S4 fallback rendering

constraints.reason: The recommendation reflects BOTH spine document order AND target element order within each document. Separate rows retain the two dimensions without promoting SHOULD to MUST.
constraints.applicability: Creator ordering of toc references, under the source recommendation.
constraints.phase: T4a navigation authoring; T6 split/reference order; S2-S4 navigation

constraints.reason: footnote/endnote/pagebreak are optional skippability terms. The next paragraph says this set is non-exhaustive; neither each term nor Reading System support for all terms is mandatory.
constraints.applicability: When a creator chooses skippability semantics for media overlays; paired vocabulary definitions and RS behavior remain separate.

constraints.reason: table/list/figure/aside are optional escapability terms, not an exhaustive mandatory set. Nested-structure advice and current support limits remain guidance rather than invented MUSTs.
constraints.applicability: When a creator chooses media-overlay escapability semantics; no executed playback claim.

constraints.reason: REC 1.5 says all algorithm explanations are non-normative. obfus-algorithm p5 expressly calls this pseudo-code an example; p3 is the unmarked explanatory repetition/copy procedure. Preserve the original source observations, not new normative steps. The p4 compression-order MUST and key/specifying MUSTs remain mapped.
constraints.applicability: Explanatory algorithm context only, not an independently imposed conformance obligation.

constraints.reason: REC 1.5 excludes all algorithm explanations. This unmarked opening describes the algorithm's modification range (including the short-file case) and is part of that explanation, not a marked compression/key/algorithm-identifier MUST. Its existing identity and literal description are retained; p2 has the same explanatory scope but is not added as a new obligation.
constraints.applicability: Font-obfuscation explanation; actual conformance MUSTs in p4, obfus-keygen and obfus-specifying are retained separately.
